name: Lariab
title: A-level Chemistry tutor · OCR A, AQA, Edexcel and all other boards · online one-to-one
bio: Lariab is a practising medical doctor who has been tutoring for eight years, with more than a thousand hours of online lessons behind her. She achieved 11 A*s at GCSE and A*AAA at A level, so she knows what the top grades take. She has over 60 five-star reviews, and the feedback from her students most often mentions her focus on exam technique and past-paper practice.

Her lessons are tailored to each student. She explains every topic clearly and makes sure it is properly understood before moving on, and she is patient and encouraging while still pushing each student to do as well as they can.

She teaches every exam board, including OCR A, AQA and Edexcel, and builds her lessons around what earns marks on the student's own papers: setting out multi-step calculations so the method marks are safe, drawing mechanisms the way the mark scheme wants them, structuring the six-mark extended answers, and the practical-skills questions that run through every paper.
offers: One-to-one online lessons for Year 12 (AS) and Year 13 (A level), at a regular weekly slot
Complete coverage of your exam board's specification, whether OCR A, AQA, Edexcel or another board, topic by topic, from moles and bonding to organic mechanisms and transition elements
Homework after every lesson, set to reinforce what that lesson covered
Regular assessments to show what is secure and what needs more work
Past-paper practice marked against your board's mark schemes, with guidance on exam technique
Harder questions and extension material for students aiming at A and A*
Progress updates and feedback for parents on request
Mock-paper walk-throughs before the May and June exams
